zip_caveats: Marble Hill is legally part of Manhattan (New York County) even though it uses the Bronx ZIP 10463, so Marble Hill voters get Manhattan's county races (1st Judicial District, Manhattan Surrogate and Civil Court) while most 10463 addresses are in the Bronx. Roosevelt Island (10044) is Manhattan. NY-10 also covers part of Brooklyn, and NY-13 part of the Bronx. Within Manhattan, your ZIP does not decide your districts; your street address does. Your ballot will have ONE of these U.S. House races: NY-10, NY-12, NY-13. ONE of these State Senate races: SD 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 31, 47, 59. ONE of these Assembly races: AD 37, 61, 65, 66, 67, 68, 69, 70, 71, 72, 73, 74, 75, 76. Civil Court municipal-district races are on the ballot only in districts 1, 3, 4, 7, 9 this year; if you live in another municipal court district you won't see one. Only voters in City Council District 3 get the Council special election. Your exact ballot: enter your address at findmypollsite.vote.nyc. ZIP lists are standard USPS residential ZIPs for the borough, compiled for this guide, not an official Board of Elections crosswalk.
